hypothesis: The unchanged SP500 fresh15 v3 route can produce attributable, source-native long and short lifecycle evidence under its frozen v51 exit and cost contract.

technical_correction.problem: The lifecycle command refetched mutable 15-minute signal candles and one-minute profit-lock candles, so revised venue snapshots could contradict prospective decisions or rewrite exits.
technical_correction.observed_failure: The first attempted replay aborted before publication because recomputed onsets did not match the prospective journal.
technical_correction.repair: Live-bound SP500 and SPCX replays now require durable first-observed 15-minute and one-minute candle prefixes. Decision-epoch and signal-warmup bounds are independent, and missing frozen exit evidence fails closed.

frozen_epoch.entry_and_exit_contract: v51 fixed 80bps stop, no fixed target, completed-1m 100/40/80 profit lock, eligible opposite-intent exit, 24h fallback

baseline_result.supersedes_artifact: v57_sp500_fresh15_shadow_lifecycle_frozen_epoch_20260819_v1.json; identical zero-lifecycle evidence generated before the final function-size refactor
baseline_result.interpretation: This proves end-to-end source reconciliation for an ineligible decision only. It is not profitability, frequency, side-breadth, or promotion evidence. The report's all-paths-resolved flag is vacuous because no lifecycle opened.

hypothesis_decision.reason: The source pipeline is now technically attributable, but the repaired epoch has zero eligible entries and zero lifecycles. The prior single profitable short remains outlier-dependent and predates the repaired one-minute exit ledger.
hypothesis_decision.reuse_policy: Do not reuse pre-repair one-minute candles as exact exit evidence. Do not relax the signal, change sides, or retune exits while this frozen source-native hypothesis is open.

minimum_update_evidence.diagnostic: At least one technically resolved lifecycle per configured side under this exact epoch and contract.
minimum_update_evidence.change_recommendation: A predeclared source-complete window with exact fees, funding, quote timing, stop behavior, profit-lock bars, opposite exits, chronological stability, and positive net results after removing the largest winner.

selected_next_investigation.action: Continue the existing report-only SP500 observer and rerun the immutable frozen-prefix lifecycle report only when a new eligible onset or material path-resolution event appears.

alternatives.tradeoff: Would increase cadence by changing the hypothesis before source-native expectancy exists.

alternatives.option: Use mutable REST snapshots for older eligible decisions
alternatives.tradeoff: Would rewrite prospective signal or exit evidence and create false exactness.

alternatives.option: Add SP500 execution authority from the zero-lifecycle baseline
alternatives.tradeoff: The baseline is technical pipeline evidence only.

confidence.reason: Focused tests, a supervised prospective one-minute row, and a source-bound real command support the repair. No repaired-epoch trade exists.

failure_modes: The observer or venue may miss a one-minute close, censoring an otherwise eligible lifecycle.
Exact mark or executable book paths may remain incomplete after entry.
Sparse or one-sided outcomes may be dominated by one winner.
A source identity, route configuration, fee tier, or execution contract change invalidates comparability.
falsifier: Update or reject this hypothesis if the frozen-prefix command cannot reproduce a future eligible journal onset, a consumed candle prefix changes, an exact lifecycle path is unresolved, both-side after-cost results are non-positive or largest-winner dependent, or the route/config/source identity changes.
